dedupe_keys.name: obb open data austrian federal railways network timetables and station data

description: The Austrian Federal Railways publish open datasets on their network and services. They include the ÖBB rail network geometry extracted from the Austrian intermodal transport reference system (GIP), as GeoJSON, shapefile and XLSX with a metadata description; route data for emergency management with the network, chainage, hectometre posts, level crossings and tunnels, updated monthly; NeTEx data on ÖBB-Infrastruktur facilities for the 2025/2026 timetable year under the EU MMTIS regulation, with train run data including cancellations and delays in CSV updated at least weekly; a GTFS timetable of ÖBB passenger services and other operators; night train routes; station and shunting location registers from the network statement; rolling stock lists and environmental data. Coverage is national (Austria). The files are free to download from the portal. Caveats: the network extract was last dated December 2023/2024, and no licence text was found on the dataset page. The data support rail network flow and capacity models, emergency management and hazard exposure of lines, tunnels and level crossings, and delay analysis. They complement the ÖBB Alpine hazards case study and the Transmodel and NeTEx standards catalogued here.
